# CFU Golden Fixtures

- `chart_v4_static_migration.canonical.json`: CFU-C2 canonical Chart v4 Writer bytes; also the
  CFU-D1/D2 v3 → v4 chart golden.
- `chart_v1_to_v4.cuexis.chart.json`: CFU-D1 v1 → v3 → v4 lift golden. Real `writeV4` LF-only
  bytes (Stage 2 v3 golden plus empty v4 arrays, `version` 4, and v4 behavior-event sort).
- `move-y.canonical.cxt`: CFU-C2 canonical CXT v1 Writer bytes.
- `cxc_v1_v4_cxt.cxc`: CFU-C3 canonical manifest-first ZIP32 Stored package bytes.
- `cxc_v1_v4_cxt.manifest.json`: manifest entry extracted from the canonical CXC package.
- `cxc_v1_v4_static.cxc`: CFU-E4 empty-animation static v4 package bytes from
  `static_project`.
- `cxc_v1_v4_static.manifest.json`: manifest entry extracted from the static v4 CXC package.
- `cfu_f_v4_reference.cxc`: CFU-F1 no-GPU reference package built from
  `cfu_f_reference_project`; it retains v3 Behavior/Step and Stop semantics while all Chart v4
  animation arrays remain empty.
- `cfu_f3_determinism.txt`: CFU-F3 LF-only cross-toolchain fingerprint for canonical CXC bytes,
  v3 → v4 migration bytes/report, Prepared semantic identity, FrameDigest v3, and capability
  diagnostic order.

The CXC format goldens are generated by the production Writer and compared byte-for-byte by the CXC
fixture test. The CFU-F1 reference package is checked against its filesystem project through the
public Playback path. v4 migration reports are checked structurally (version, empty animation arrays,
64-hex identities) by the migration unit tests. CFU-F3 additionally pins the reference migration
report SHA-256 in its aggregate fingerprint. The pairing v3 source is
`tests/fixtures/chart_format_update/valid/chart_v3_static_migration.json`.
